card.title: How To Fix iPhone X With No WiFi. Grayed Out Button

source.title: How To Fix iPhone X With No WiFi. Grayed Out Button

claims.statement: iPhone X greyed-out Wi-Fi usually needs a bottom board swap because the bottom layer and interposer crack near the SIM tray.
Confirm by pairing the top board with a working bottom board using the same modem type after unbinding Wi-Fi; swap BB CPU, BB EEPROM, optionally NFC, and the Wi-Fi IC.

procedure: Check for bending near the SIM slot.
Swap paired chips and verify Wi-Fi, touch and 'No SIM'.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
